description: Create a folder-backed Nas.com product such as digital files or a course. Before offering this action or requesting its inputs, check business permissions. FREE businesses cannot use this tool, regardless of individual feature rows. Call check_business_tool_access before collecting inputs. Show any grace-period warning and verified resubscribe link before continuing, and never proceed when access is blocked.

amount.description: Price amount in the business currency.

communityId.description: Nas.com business (community) ID. Use an ID returned by list_businesses or another Nas.com tool; never invent one.

coverMediaItems.description: Cover images or videos for the product.

currency.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code, for example USD.

status.description: Status value; use one of the allowed values in this schema.

templateId.description: Template ID, from the template listing.

tieredPrices.description: Price tiers to save for the business.

type.description: Type value; use one of the allowed values in this schema.

name: create_folder_product
title: Create Folder Product
